_comment: UP-10c menu (owner go 2026-11-04). One item = one (model + native thinking) pair Jev may pick. thinking: null = provider default (no field), else {control: effort|toggle, value}. Native values are policy data from effort-pairs-research (audit-code); the ones here are the 2026-10-22 measured levels until that lands. rank: higher = heavier/costlier (stickiness only switches DOWN after sticky.downgrade_after turns Jev rates simpler). backups: tried in order after the head, each with its own thinking; same model on another account/provider goes first once one is registered, then P2. gpt-6-luna is not on the menu (owner OK 2026-11-04).

items.label: Quick
items.description: quick answers with very little thinking: greetings, small talk, a single fact, a short rewrite or translation

items.label: Everyday
items.description: everyday requests with normal thinking: ordinary questions, explanations, writing and summaries in Indonesian or English, standard code

items.label: Careful expert
items.description: careful expert answers for law, health, science, history, programming, web pages and charts; says plainly when it is unsure; takes more time

items.label: Deep reasoning
items.description: hard multi-step reasoning: maths, proofs, puzzles, difficult debugging and careful planning; thinks for a long time before answering

items.label: Agent and tools
items.description: multi-step work with tools: running code, reading and writing files, building or changing a project over many steps

items.label: Business and IT
items.description: business and IT work: spreadsheets, office documents, business emails, system administration, networks and IT support
